scope: Single-CPU Linux with translated ARM64 userspace; PTE/window comparison and instruction-boundary preemption fix; Android desktop and iPhone integration pending

matrix.scope: Matched translated guest and preamble; balanced mapping order; 128 round trips per case

preemption_regression.scope: Deterministic stop request from a successful data TLB fill; four ARM64 memory instructions

instruction_preemption.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; no Android/iPhone integration
instruction_preemption.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.

native_validation.scope: Native CLI/GCD base regression after sharing capacity test; NCE_SYSTEM_SERVER_PROBE unset; no full Launcher/Clock/Files desktop run

limitations: Benchmarks compare two translated backends with identical guest files and preamble; native product has a different overall working set.
Sample means include phase boundaries; sampled peaks may miss short peaks. The 640 MiB capacity test dominates the guest-execution footprint peak.
Timer interval is a request interval; actual exit occurs at the next translated block boundary.
Only AArch64 ET_DYN with current 16 KiB layout and explicit dynamic-code publication protocol is covered.

configuration_correction.cause: TCG buffer size was set after UC_CTL_TLB_TYPE initialized the engine. The setter updated the configuration field without reallocating the cache.
configuration_correction.interpretation: Recorded requested sizes are not effective capacities. 16/64 MiB rows do not compare different capacities. Other timing observations retain their original workload scope.
